create.name: Giovanni Bartolomeo
create.bio:
Giovanni (Gio) Bartolomeo is a Canadian breathwork teacher and life coach who created Elemental Rhythm, a style of guided breathing set to music that also draws on movement, meditation and reflective questions. His own path ran through cold-water and breath training with Wim Hof and through traditional ayahuasca ceremonies, and he still describes himself as someone always looking for the next experience that widens awareness. He first taught his method at Elemental Wellness, the studio he ran in Toronto, and is also a co-founder of The Personal Development School.

When the studio closed in the spring of 2020 he turned the method into an online platform and a training school. More than a hundred people have since qualified as Elemental Rhythm facilitators, and he leads the facilitator and integration-coach trainings online and at in-person venues alongside a team of educators. Members can practise with a library of guided breath journeys, short courses and reflective exercises through the Elemental Rhythm app. On his YouTube channel and his Giocast podcast he talks frankly about breathwork, meaning, faith and how to make sense of psychedelic experiences, and he made a free documentary on plant medicine called Psyched Out.

courses.title: Breathwork Facilitator Training – Nov | Online
courses.description: A two-day live online certification in leading Elemental Rhythm breath journeys for groups and individuals. It covers structure, music, holding space and working safely with what comes up in a session.

courses.title: Breathwork Integration Coach Training – Feb | Online
courses.description: A two-day online training for facilitators who want to support clients after a breath session. It blends life-coaching methods with body-based tools and the school's visioning process.

courses.title: Elemental Rhythm App Membership
courses.description: A monthly membership that opens the full library of guided breath journeys, short courses and reflective exercises on phone or computer. A few tracks can be tried free first.

free_resources.title: Rhythm Begins With You: Free 5-Day Breathwork Journey
free_resources.description: A free five-day introduction delivered to your phone, with a short breath practice each day and a taste of the school's coaching approach.

free_resources.title: Guide to Becoming a Breathwork Facilitator
free_resources.description: A free guide for anyone weighing up whether to train as a breathwork facilitator, outlining what the role involves.
